capabilities.name: Sign up for the big AI assistants
capabilities.question: Can an ordinary person here sign up for at least two of the big AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Copilot, Alexa+)?

US.note: ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini can each be signed up for in the US: all three publish the US on their supported-countries pages. Alexa+ is also open to everyone, free with Prime. Copilot was not checked.

evidence.title: Alexa+ is now available to everyone in the US, free with Prime

GB.note: ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini can each be signed up for in the UK: all three publish the UK on their supported-countries pages. Alexa+ is also here, in free Early Access. Copilot was not checked.

evidence.title: Introducing Alexa+ in the UK: The Next Generation of Alexa

DE.note: ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini can each be signed up for in Germany: all three publish Germany on their supported-countries pages. Alexa+ has been in free Early Access in German since May 2026: you get it with a new Echo, or sign up for an invitation. Copilot was not checked.

evidence.title: Alexa+ arrives in Japan as Amazon's next-generation AI assistant expands internationally (list of Alexa+ countries)

IN.note: ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini can each be signed up for in India: all three publish India on their supported-countries pages. Alexa+ is also here, in free Early Access since September 2026. Copilot was not checked.

BR.note: ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini can each be signed up for in Brazil: all three publish Brazil on their supported-countries pages. Alexa+ is also here, in free Early Access since June 2026. Copilot was not checked.

evidence.title: Alexa+ chega ao Brasil: a assistente de IA de última geração da Amazon
Alexa+ arrives in Japan as Amazon's next-generation AI assistant expands internationally (list of Alexa+ countries)

MX.note: ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini can each be signed up for in Mexico: all three publish Mexico on their supported-countries pages. Alexa+ is also here, in free Early Access. Copilot was not checked.

evidence.title: Alexa+ arrives in Japan as Amazon's next-generation AI assistant expands internationally (list of Alexa+ countries)

CL.note: ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini can each be signed up for in Chile: all three publish Chile on their supported-countries pages. Alexa+ is not offered here: Chile is not on Amazon's list of Alexa+ countries. Copilot was not checked.

evidence.title: Alexa+ arrives in Japan as Amazon's next-generation AI assistant expands internationally (list of Alexa+ countries)

CO.note: ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini can each be signed up for in Colombia: all three publish Colombia on their supported-countries pages. Alexa+ is not offered here: Colombia is not on Amazon's list of Alexa+ countries. Copilot was not checked.

evidence.title: Alexa+ arrives in Japan as Amazon's next-generation AI assistant expands internationally (list of Alexa+ countries)

ES.note: ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini can each be signed up for in Spain: all three publish Spain on their supported-countries pages. Alexa+ has been in free Early Access in Spain since 23 April 2026 (later €22.99 a month, or free with Prime). Copilot was not checked.

evidence.title: Alexa+ arrives in Japan as Amazon's next-generation AI assistant expands internationally (list of Alexa+ countries; Spain Early Access since 23 April 2026)
Alexa+ ya disponible en España: la nueva generación de Alexa

FR.note: ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini can each be signed up for in France: all three publish France on their supported-countries pages. Alexa+ has been in Early Access in France since 26 May 2026. Copilot was not checked.

evidence.title: Alexa+ arrives in Japan as Amazon's next-generation AI assistant expands internationally (list of Alexa+ countries; France since 26 May 2026)

CA.note: Claude and Gemini both list Canada on their supported-countries pages, and Alexa+ left Early Access in Canada on 11 June 2026: it is now open to everyone, free with Prime. ChatGPT and Copilot were not checked.

evidence.title: Alexa+ now available to everyone in Canada and free for Prime members
Alexa+ arrives in Japan as Amazon's next-generation AI assistant expands internationally (list of Alexa+ countries)

JP.note: Claude and Gemini both list Japan on their supported-countries pages, so the cell is live. Alexa+ began rolling out in Japan on 29 October 2026 in free Early Access. ChatGPT and Copilot were not checked, because OpenAI's country page cannot be opened by script.

evidence.title: Alexa+ arrives in Japan as Amazon's next-generation AI assistant expands internationally

AU.note: Claude and Gemini both list Australia on their supported-countries pages, and Alexa+ has been in free Early Access in Australia since 6 August 2026. ChatGPT is also offered here, but we did not re-check its help page, which blocks scripts. Copilot was not checked.

evidence.title: Alexa+ arrives in Japan as Amazon's next-generation AI assistant expands internationally (list of Alexa+ countries)

NG.note: ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini can each be signed up for in Nigeria: all three list Nigeria on their supported-countries pages. Alexa+ is not offered here: Nigeria is not on Amazon's list of Alexa+ countries. Copilot was not checked.

evidence.title: Alexa+ arrives in Japan as Amazon's next-generation AI assistant expands internationally (list of Alexa+ countries)

KR.note: ChatGPT and Gemini can both be signed up for in South Korea: OpenAI's supported-countries list and Gemini's country list both name it. Claude's country list also names Korea, but with an effective date of 12 November 2026, so it does not count yet. Copilot was not checked.

SG.note: Claude and Gemini can each be signed up for in Singapore: Anthropic's supported-countries page and Google's Gemini app help page both list it. Alexa+ is not yet available here, since Amazon's launch country list does not include Singapore.

ID.note: Gemini is open in Indonesia and lists Indonesian as a language. ChatGPT and Claude are also on their companies' country lists, but we could see those pages only through a search result and an Anthropic page with a 12 November 2026 effective date, so confidence is low. Alexa+ is not in Indonesia, and Copilot was not checked.

IT.note: Gemini lists Italy among the countries where Gemini Apps are available, so you can sign up today. Claude also lists Italy, and Alexa+ has been in invitation-only early access in Italy since April 2026. ChatGPT was not checked, because its help page blocks scripts.

evidence.title: Alexa+ in Italia da oggi, gratis

NL.note: Gemini and Claude can each be signed up for in the Netherlands: both publish the country on their supported-countries pages. Claude's page shows an effective date of 12 November 2026, so we keep this low confidence. ChatGPT was not checked, and Alexa+ is not usable in the Netherlands.

capabilities.name: Use agent features in your own language
capabilities.question: Do the agent features, not only the chat, work in the main language of the country?

US.note: English is the main language. Alexa+ is open to all in the US, Claude in Chrome is generally available on paid Claude plans, and Google's Chrome auto browse launched here. The Gemini mobile app lists English, and its connected apps, such as WhatsApp, Phone and Messages, work in every language and country of the mobile app.
